title: Private durable caller-workspace policy capture acceptance
description: A capture receipt before physical Run or session activation; it does not activate public successor adapters. The complete JCS receipt is bounded to 64 MiB, independently of the 65,536-byte combined raw instruction-source ceiling.
x-invariants: OrchestrationStore atomically retains this immutable JCS receipt and its SHA-256 in caller_policy_session_acceptances; this extension does not reinterpret legacy session rows or publish a physical Run, thread, or active session.
session_id equals root_run_id; both are UUID7. SQL session/root/workspace/request indexes exactly match the retained receipt.
home_root is the canonical Dolgorae home, canonical_workspace derives workspace_id, and the storing state root is home_root/workspaces/workspace_id.
configuration and Profile-binding key sets equal the unique policy role_ref set; each configuration retains exactly its installed Role capture and full accepted Profile binding digest.
Every child has the same exact common capture admitted once at bootstrap. Composition, individual source digests, and the combined raw source ceiling are revalidated from retained bytes.
Request identity and all captured bytes are immutable; exact repetition returns the same receipt and conflicting input fails. Retry lookup occurs before source admission.
Recovery and child reactivation read the accepted receipt without reopening common, Role, installed-policy, or Profile authoring inputs. Observer lookup does not create or recover database state.
